title: feat(app-shell): the marketplace package page offers the install modes a package permits, and reads the door's answer (objectui#12288)
body:
Fixes #12288
Clause-②: yes

The marketplace package page offers the install modes a package permits (managed, or an unmanaged copy), sends `installMode` on the install, lists the locks an unmanaged copy dropped, and shows each install-mode refusal's own message. This is the objectui stage S4 of objectstack-ai/objectstack#15213 (ADR-0131 D6). The console has no mode rule of its own: what is permitted is the manifest's `installModes`, and what happened is the door's answer.

## What the page reads, measured on objectstack `main` `e540e7ffb`

- **The `installModes` key is read from the manifest the install door judges.** The PM's hypothesis that it reaches the page "through a payload the page already reads" is false. The page read two payloads: the catalog detail (`GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages/:id`, the control plane's `sys_package` row, passed through verbatim by `MarketplaceProxyPlugin`) and the install-local listing. Neither carries the key in anything this session can measure. The cloud repo is not attached here, and egress to the live catalog is refused by the container proxy, so the detail's projection stays unmeasured. The door itself fetches `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages/:id/versions/VERSION/manifest` and judges `installModes` on that payload's `data.manifest` (`judgeInstallMode` in `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`). The browse proxy forwards every GET under `/api/v1/marketplace/` except `install-local`. So the page now reads that same path, at `latest`, the version install-local fetches when it is given no `versionId`, which is how the page installs. The key is read where the door reads it (`declaredPackageManifest`): on a compiled artifact's nested `manifest:`, else at the top of a flat body.
- **Only install-local takes a mode.** `POST /api/v1/cloud-connection/install` takes `package_id` and `seed_sample_data` and forwards nothing else. So the read and the choice exist only where `features.installLocal` makes install-local the page's door.
- **A package permitting only `unmanaged`** is refused by the door when no mode is sent (the door's own test: "refuses `managed` for a copy-only package — 422, naming `unmanaged`"). The page sends the one mode a manifest declares. That follows from the manifest and the door, not from a console rule. Such a package draws no choice, but the page says before the click that the install is a copy.
- **`strippedLocks`** is `{ type, name, lock, reason? }` (`ImportUnmanagedPackageResponseSchema`, objectstack-ai/objectstack#23075), with `lock` one of the spec's `MetadataLock` values except `none`. The unmanaged install and the lock strip ship in the same pending v18 changesets (`15213-install-modes.md`, `15213-unmanaged-lock-strip.md`). No released runtime answers `unmanaged` without the list, so it is typed required and read with no fallback.

## What changed

- `marketplaceApi.ts`: `getDeclaredInstallModes(packageId, versionId = 'latest')` reads the key as above. It returns `undefined` for an absent key and for a declaration the spec refuses. The door refuses such a package whatever mode is sent, so the page shows the door's message. Absence is never resolved to a default here. A mode named twice counts once. `installLocal` takes an optional `installMode` and sends it only when named. `LocalInstallResult` is now the managed or the unmanaged answer. `LocalInstallMode` and `LocalInstallStrippedLock` are the console's reading of the install door's `installMode` and `strippedLocks`; the `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 objectui resolves declares neither (only `lock` is typed from the spec's `MetadataLock`). `isPlainRecord` is imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`.
- `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`:
  - The choice is a radio group under the description, drawn only when the manifest permits more than one mode. It starts unpicked, because the spec ranks no permitted mode above another (the same shape as `PackagesPage`'s delete-mode choice). The install button waits for a pick. While it waits, the disabled Install says why (`marketplace.install.mode.required`): a focusable wrapper opens the reason on hover and focus, and it is the button's accessible description.
  - No `installModes`, or no readable manifest: no choice and no `installMode` sent, so the door's default stands. One declared mode: no choice, and that mode is sent.
  - An `unmanaged` answer gets its own sentence naming the base, and its `strippedLocks` list shows each item, its lock and the package's reason verbatim. It mounts no install-time suggestions, since nothing is registered under the package's id. Before this, the answer carried no `hotLoaded` and would have read as "loads when the runtime next restarts".
  - The three refusals (`INSTALL_MODE_NOT_PERMITTED`, `UNMANAGED_INSTALL_WALLED_POSTURE`, `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`) fall through to the existing branch that shows the envelope's `message`. No console sentence replaces them.
  - A copy that was asked for and answered without `installMode: 'unmanaged'` comes from a runtime that predates the key and installed the package managed. The page says so, the reading `os package install --install-mode` makes.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, all ten packs: nine keys under `marketplace.install` (`mode.label`, `mode.required`, `mode.managed`, `mode.managedHint`, `mode.unmanaged`, `mode.unmanagedHint`, `unmanagedSuccess`, `unmanagedStrippedLocks`, `unmanagedIgnored`).
- `.changeset/12288-marketplace-install-mode.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, `minor`.

**Clause-② yes:** the published `@object-ui/i18n` packs gain nine keys. `installLocal`, `getDeclaredInstallModes` and the new types live in `marketplaceApi.ts`, which is not exported from the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry. The exported `MarketplacePackagePage` keeps its props.

## Verification

All at `d5441f2` unless a line says otherwise. Patch round 1 (head `6618b25`: `isPlainRecord` imported from the spec for `check:spec-symbols`, and the disabled Install's reason) has its readings in the os-dev report on objectui#12288. Every heavy run went through `os-verify-lock.sh`; each reading is that command's own `VERDICT` or summary line.

- **Dependency closure:** `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **The two touched dirs, at `d5441f2`:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/` passed 115 test files (1534 tests passed, 13 skipped), exit 0.
- **The two touched packages in full, at `50ec625`:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/ packages/i18n/` gave 1398 files passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped (14023 tests passed, 2 failed).
  - The failure was `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`. It counts the German pack's matched quote pairs, and the two new `„{{name}}“` spans move it from 85 to 87. The count is updated in `adf0131`, as each earlier PR adding such a span did, and that file is green in the run above.
  - Since `50ec625`, app-shell's source changed only by `installLocal`'s overload signatures. esbuild's output for `marketplaceApi.ts` is identical at `50ec625` and `d5441f2` (control: BASE's output differs), so the full-suite reading stands for HEAD's runtime code.
- **`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`** (echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
  - It was exit 2 at `adf0131`. The union return type hid `hotLoaded` from the catalog page's org-package install in `MarketplacePage.tsx`, which sends no mode.
  - The fix is in `marketplaceApi.ts`: an overload types a request that names no mode with the managed answer, the door's own rule. `MarketplacePage.tsx` is not edited.
  - `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test file (control: a sibling test file is listed too).
- **`pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`:** exit 0.
- **Lock-free gates,** each exit 0:
  - `pnpm check:i18n-keys`;
  - `pnpm check:i18n-drift`: 8 keys added, 0 `en` values changed;
  - `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`: none of the eight keys is a candidate;
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`;
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new;
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- **ESLint, a declared narrowing to the 14 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files:** 0 errors and 47 warnings. That is the same per-file count as BASE for the two edited source files (11 and 36), and 0 for the rest.
  - Population: the `**/*.{ts,tsx}` block of `eslint.config.js`. File count: read from `--format json`.
  - Invariance: the config is not type-aware (`tseslint.configs.recommended`, no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move the verdict of a file it does not touch. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

**Reverse verification, at `50ec625`.** Each ablation mutated through an anchor that had to hit (objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode), ran `MarketplacePackagePage.installMode-12288.test.tsx` (17 tests), and restored. Each restore was proven by a blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The test imports the page and `marketplaceApi.ts` from `src`, so no build sat between a mutation and its run. The expected directions were declared before the run, and each was observed:

- **A1, the page sends no `installMode`:** 6 red (the five sent-mode pins and the ignored-copy pin).
- **A2, the choice is never offered:** 9 red (both-modes ×2, picked ×2, the managed control, the three refusals, the ignored copy).
- **A3, the unmanaged answer is not read:** 2 red (the stripped-locks pin and its no-lock control).
- **A4, the nested `manifest:` is not read:** 1 red (the compiled-artifact case).

## Acceptance notes

- **No docs page carries this flow.** No objectui guide describes the package page's install flow (`content/docs/guide/console.md` names the marketplace route only), so AGENTS.md #2 has no page to update. The authoring page for install modes is objectstack's `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx`. Carrier: none.
- **An unmanaged copy is not visible on the page afterwards.** The install-local listing lists only ledgered installs, and a copy writes no ledger entry under the package's id. After a copy the page still offers Install, and a managed pick is then refused `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, whose message names the base. No served read tells the page a copy exists. Carrier: none.
- **`seeded.mode: 'skipped'` is not shown.** The unmanaged answer says so when the package declares sample data; the page does not repeat it. Carrier: none.
- **The local mirror types** (`LocalInstallMode`, `LocalInstallStrippedLock`) are for replacement by `InstallModeSchema` / `ImportUnmanagedPackageResponse` once objectui resolves an `@objectstack/spec` that exports them. Carrier: the PR that moves objectui to `@objectstack` 18.
- **A stale backend pointer.** The local-install block header in `marketplaceApi.ts` points at the install door's former framework path; the door lives in objectstack `packages/cloud-connection/src/`. Not edited here. Carrier: none.

Built for objectui#12288 in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01RZYixBnXPWvcm2YenWo6eJ` (`claude/issue-12288-marketplace-install-mode`).
